htn_kidney.title: Novel protein biomarkers for risk stratification and personalized medicine.
htn_kidney.journal: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
htn_kidney.authors: Moedt E, Ju W, Nair V
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：尿簇蛋白和表皮生长因子（uEGF）分别与肾小管损伤和修复相关，并且可以作为机制知情的药效生物标志物。 临床提示：蛋白尿广泛用于监测慢性肾脏病 (CKD) 和治疗反应，但存在变异性，主要反映肾小球损伤。
htn_kidney.abstract: Albuminuria is widely used to monitor chronic kidney disease (CKD) and treatment response but is subject to variability and primarily reflects glomerular injury. Urinary clusterin and epidermal growth factor (uEGF) are associated with tubular injury and repair, respectively, and may serve as mechanism-informed pharmacodynamic biomarkers. We investigated responses of urinary clusterin and uEGF to endothelin receptor antagonists (ERA) and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), respectively, in CKD. We evaluated changes in urinary clusterin-to-creatinine ratio (uCLU/Cr) and uEGF-to-creatinine ratio (uEGF/Cr) in two randomized CKD trial populations. Effects of ERA on uCLU/Cr and end...

portal_hypertension.title: Challenges in the management of vascular liver disorders in women in the reproductive period.
portal_hypertension.journal: Indian journal of gastroenterology : official journal of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：它们通常与遗传性或获得性血栓形成倾向有关。 临床提示：这些疾病可能通过改变月经周期影响女性的生殖健康并影响生育能力。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Vascular liver diseases (VLD) are a heterogeneous cohort of uncommon hepatic diseases which affect individuals particularly in the reproductive age group. They are typically associated with inherited or acquired thrombophilia. These diseases may influence reproductive health in women through alteration of the menstrual cycle and impact fertility. Pregnancy in this patient group may be complicated by exacerbation of portal hypertension, maternal and fetal complications due to underlying liver disease or drugs used for its management. This review focuses on the known risk factors of VLD in women, along with their prevalence and management. Special situations such as impact and use of anti-coag...

portal_hypertension.title: Non-selective beta blockers are well tolerated in pregnancy with portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.journal: Indian journal of gastroenterology : official journal of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.authors: Alexander V, John A, Benjamin S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 54）。核心观点：该研究旨在评估门静脉高压症的病程和非选择性β受体阻滞剂（NSBB）对门静脉高压症孕妇的安全性。 临床提示：这项回顾性研究纳入了孕前或怀孕期间诊断出患有门静脉高压（​​PHT）的孕妇。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The study aimed at assessing the course of portal hypertension and safety of non-selective beta blockers (NSBB) in pregnant patients with portal hypertension. Pregnant women with portal hypertension (PHT), diagnosed preconceptionally or during pregnancy, were included in this retrospective study. Medical records were assessed for NSBB prescription, liver decompensation (ascites, variceal bleed, hepatic encephalopathy), overall and pregnancy-related outcomes. All outcomes were documented at discharge from the hospital. One-hundred thirty-four pregnancies in 93 patients (median age: 26, range [17-39 years]). The study included 54 primigravidas. portal_hypertension.title: Real-World Study of Management and Outcomes of Patients with Lysosomal Acid Lipase Deficiency (LAL-D) in France.
portal_hypertension.authors: Lacaille F, Marguet S, Rascon Velasco V
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 43）。核心观点：溶酶体酸性脂肪酶缺乏症（LAL-D）是一种罕见的遗传性溶酶体贮积病，导致器官和组织中脂质积聚。 临床提示：严重程度各异，从快速进展的婴儿型到不太严重的迟发型。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Lysosomal acid lipase deficiency (LAL-D) is a rare inherited lysosomal storage disease leading to accumulation of lipids in organs and tissues. Severity varies from a rapidly progressive infantile form to a less severe, later-onset form. This study aimed to describe patients with LAL-D identified between 2007 and 2020, their treatment, and the burden of disease in France. A retrospective longitudinal study was conducted using nationwide claims data from the French National Health Data System (SNDS). Male and female patients were identified as having a diagnosis of LAL-D or having been administered sebelipase alfa, the only approved treatment. Of 43 patients with LAL-D identified, 17 and 26 h...

portal_hypertension.title: Primary sclerosing cholangitis.
portal_hypertension.authors: von Seth E, Karlsen TH, Tanaka A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：50-80% 的原发性硬化性胆管炎患者同时患有炎症性肠病，并且肝胆癌和结直肠癌的风险增加。 临床提示：原发性硬化性胆管炎是一种罕见的慢性胆汁淤积性肝病，以胆道炎症和纤维化为特征。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Primary sclerosing cholangitis is a rare, chronic cholestatic liver disease characterised by biliary inflammation and fibrosis. Inflammatory bowel disease co-occurs in 50-80% of individuals with primary sclerosing cholangitis and there is an increased risk for hepatobiliary and colorectal cancers. Primary sclerosing cholangitis presentation is highly variable but there is usually a slowly progressive fibrosis of the bile ducts with strictures, development of liver fibrosis and cirrhosis, and eventually a need for liver transplantation, after which primary sclerosing cholangitis can reoccur.
